protocol.input: H=8 xyz execution perturbations and D2 block-pose trajectories sampled at simulator hold steps 5,10,20,29,30; robot motion conditions prediction but is not scored
protocol.branch: two RBF-GP surfaces on linearly separated action regions
protocol.decision: branch evidence minus smooth evidence and split-search description length is positive at both hold 10 and hold 30
protocol.candidate: best residual-PC1 or trajectory-PC1 split; candidates charged in MDL
